lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I have knelt on that stone every morning for thirty years and it is not there yet. It is in the quarry. I find that harder than the drowned streets.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: We bought the wall and the wall bought us. I am going to be very careful about what I say to Ilse from here.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Poor and open. That is the order I joined. Thank you, Auditor.
